Subject: Clarification regarding your recent email

Dear [Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to seek clarification on a few points in your recent email to ensure I provide the most relevant assistance.

First, regarding the instruction to "name the shape with three sides," could you please clarify the context of this request? I want to make sure I understand whether this is a standalone question, part of a larger task, or if there is a specific document or project it relates to.

Second, regarding the request to forward documents from our previous discussion and provide thoughts on how to proceed, I would be happy to share the relevant files. To ensure my feedback is as useful as possible, could you please specify which particular aspects of the project or next steps you would like me to focus on?

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your guidance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
